title: A quieter Seoul comes alive after dark
caption:
Seoul extended operating hours across major historic landmarks and museums this autumn, introducing evening tea sessions, night runs, and courtyard ceremonies. The shift into the dark has already boosted attendance two- to threefold.

Source: Koreaherald - A quieter Seoul comes alive after dark
